entrance_half_angle.note: High-energy side penetration and host shielding preclude a uniform geometric lower bound.

approximate_low_thresholds.note: Not every counter: S3 Table I gives channel-dependent responses.

heavy_ion_channel_threshold.note: Approximate reported threshold, not a lower response to all GCR heavy ions or to memory LET.

broadcast_period.note: Period, not acquisition duration or worst-case latency/jitter.

packet_size.note: Word width and full wire framing not given here; do not convert to bytes.

radiation_words.note: Dead-time-corrected preselected proton/electron/deep-dose scalers; not proved raw Poisson counts.

processing_rate.note: Electronics processing capability; not a hard count-loss/saturation or full-channel bound.

deadtime_correction.note: Does not establish a pathwise or stochastic count-loss bound.

generic_SREM_mass.note: Generic PSI profile; S3 quotes 2.6 kg for its description. Not a measured IREM delivery cost.

existing_interface.value: Host-compatible TM/TC, status/temperature; generic differential or single-ended lines. IREM broadcasts TDB including status and science/HK.
existing_interface.source: S1 Host Spacecraft Accomodation; S4 p. 2 section 4

detector_area.source: S5 p. 46; S7 Table 1 p. 4, STRV rows

entrance_half_angle.note: Rear detections possible; spacecraft-dependent angular lower bound unknown.

shielding.source: S7 p. 3 Fig. 2; p. 4 Table 1 STRV

typical_integration.note: Typical, not minimum or mandatory. Two histograms transferred to spacecraft memory.

design_processable_rate.note: Shield/design target, not certified hard saturation bound.

deadtime_support.value: Built-in test pulser; regular dead-time measurement interpolated per accumulation; corrected rate = raw rate/(1-t_D).
deadtime_support.note: No uniform interpolation/loss bound or probability contract is supplied.

ion_support.value: Two highest bins expected to include ions; described flight counts not significant.
ion_support.note: Neither zero GCR sensitivity nor full GCR-memory coverage follows.

existing_interface.value: Digital TM/TC to on-board computer, two accumulated histograms to spacecraft memory; acquisition followed by voltage/temperature HK. Test-pulser support.
existing_interface.note: Transfer mechanism does not specify a bound to rule software or freshness/overflow fields.
